study_identification_part.si_4_title: Effects of anterior temporal lobe resection on cortical morphology

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized additive mixed models (GAMM) were used for normative modeling to account for age, sex, and scanning protocol effects on cortical morphology measures. The model was trained on 924 healthy controls using the R package mgcv with restricted maximum likelihood for smoothing parameter estimation.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we performed a correction of these measures based on a normative model of the controls using generalised additive mixed models (GAMM) for each patch on the cortical surface. This correction accounts for differences due to age, sex, and scanning protocol. We did this with the R package mgcv
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Leiberg2023.pdf.md: Section 2.5 Age, sex and scanning protocol correction

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Response variables included traditional morphological measures: cortical thickness (T), total surface area (At), and exposed surface area (Ae). Additionally, three independent morphological measures derived from these were used: K (tension term), I (isometric size term), and S (shape term). These measures were computed locally using a surface-based approach with 3 cm radius patches.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: We used a surface-based method to locally compute traditional morphological variables, and the independent measures K, I, and S, where K measures white matter tension, I captures isometric scaling, and S contains the remaining information about cortical shape.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Leiberg2023.pdf.md: Abstract and Section 2.3 Computation of localised morphological measures

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The GAMM model included: (1) age as a smooth spline term s(age) to capture non-linear age effects, (2) sex as a fixed effect with coefficient b, and (3) scanning protocol as a random effect. The model formula was: y ~ b*sex + s(age) + ε, protocol.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: We trained a model with the formula y ~ b*sex + s(age) + ε, protocol ... where b is a model coefficient, s is a smooth spline, ε is the error term ... We used the controls to provide a normative model of age and sex with scanning protocol as a random effect.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Leiberg2023.pdf.md: Section 2.5 Age, sex and scanning protocol correction
